_howto: Words to add to the game. Run: node scripts/extract-kerning.js (preview), then node scripts/extract-kerning.js --write (save). Add/remove entries below freely. A plain string = auto-pick which gaps are editable; an object with "editable" = pick manually by letterIndex (position of the LEFT letter of the gap, 1-based: in "Valor" the V·a gap is 1, a·l is 2, l·o is 3, o·r is 4).
